headline: Exploited flaws in MONAI Label and Idunno.AntiCsrf need action; 1Password reports a source-code theft
plain_summary: Two software flaws are confirmed as exploited by attackers: one in a medical imaging tool and one in an old web security library with no patch. 1Password says an attacker used an employee's GitHub account to take some account records and source code, but not vault contents. Microsoft says a flaw exposed customer contact metadata. Administrators of the affected products should act; 1Password users need no account changes.

items.title: Idunno.AntiCsrf flaw CVE-2026-131914 exploited; no patch exists
items.why: Mandiant reports active exploitation of a CVSS 9.3 deserialization flaw in an unmaintained ASP.NET library, and it is on CISA's KEV list.
items.action: Stop using Idunno.AntiCsrf, replace it with a maintained anti-CSRF library, and audit Web.config files and bin/ directories for references to it.

items.title: AI agents exploit MONAI Label zero-day to gain root on a server
items.why: Amazon says AI agents running the Cairn tool exploited a path traversal flaw within 11 minutes of mapping the API; the event is still developing.
items.action: Update MONAI Label to 0.8.6 after testing, keep servers off the direct internet, and check for unexpected files such as sitecustomize.py.

items.title: N-able Mail Assure and SpamExperts server accessed
items.why: N-able confirms one hosted server was accessed and found no evidence of customer data compromise; a separate SSRF flaw, CVE-2026-134624, was found during the investigation.
items.action: SpamExperts Local Cloud operators should confirm they run build 20261121.1943; Hosted Cloud users have nothing to install.

items.title: Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-104935 probed by scanners
items.why: F5 Labs recorded 46 exploitation attempts from 4 source IPs against a flaw that has been on CISA's KEV list since October 13.
items.action: Patch now and apply Ivanti's fixed version, ICS 25.1.3.0.

items.title: 1Password: employee GitHub account used to take records and code
items.why: 1Password confirms account records for a subset of users, some invitation and recovery tokens and source code were taken; it says vaults were never accessed.
items.action: 1Password advises that no action is needed in your account, and to be cautious of unexpected emails, texts or calls about 1Password, invitations or account recovery.

items.title: Entra Connect Health flaw exposed customer metadata
items.why: Microsoft confirms read-only access to tenant IDs, domain names and technical contacts' emails from 23 July; it says no passwords or keys were exposed.
items.action: Administrators should run Microsoft's read-only PowerShell audit script, strengthen phishing-resistant multifactor authentication, and confirm notification recipients are legitimate.

items.title: Microsoft Office LTSC flaw CVE-2026-112732 allows remote code execution
items.why: GovCERT.HK says a patch is available for Office LTSC 2021 and 2024; neither source says the flaw is exploited.
items.action: Apply the patches from Windows Update or the Microsoft Update Catalog and follow the vendor's recommendations.

items.title: South Korea briefs firms on amended network act
items.why: Companies must designate an executive CISO, notify affected users of breaches, and can face fines if breached repeatedly.
